headline: SEA @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.30 at DET 2.75, with a projected total of 7.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.33 runs while DET moved +0.07, changing the projected margin by +0.27 runs. The projected total climbed +0.40, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Bryce Miller has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Josh Naylor, J.P. Crawford, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
